title: ‘Monsoon comes with element of surprise’ | The Star
text:
‘Monsoon comes with element of surprise’ | The Star
PETALING JAYA: There will be a variety to weather patterns but Malaysians can always expect the monsoon to come, says Universiti Malaya’s Prof Datuk Dr Azizan Abu Samah.
He said the monsoon weather would continue to occur, but it could either come earlier or later.
